judge: python3 docs/lanes/nfsaudio1011/tools/fixjudge.py OFF:<1> ON:<2> ON:<3> OFF:<4>  (reference 0-1791764924-lane.local-837057 for the content slope; PSA window 2.27-17.27 s of 837057's output)
baseline: Identify run 1-1791770282-lane.nfsaudio1011-2057093 (NOTES.md): the game keeps its write head 992 samples past the CBO at every burst start (2937 of 2950) and writes once per burst, 1.7/5.8/9.5 ms (p10/50/90) after it; the VP runs 64 or 128 VP frames (2048 or 4096 samples) per burst after each drain, so it passes the head 1024 samples in (32*boff - ahead = +32 in 56% of bursts, within +/-256 in 67.9%). Output lag-2400 share in shipped behaviour: 15.1% (837057), 16.4% (836989), 20.0% (836907), 30.6% (651467), 31.2% (2057093). Content slope 0-25 s: 1.000, 0.997, 0.996, 0.707, 0.754. gfps median 59.0 in all. Level -22.96..-23.13 dBFS ac-rms.
prediction: HAKUX_APU_PACE=1 runs throttle()'s low-watermark pacing on Android: one EP frame (8 VP frames, 256 samples) per 5.33 ms once the monitor fifo is above the low watermark, instead of a drain period's worth of VP frames back to back. The VP then moves the CBO 256 samples at a time, under the game's 992-sample lead, and the game's writer (cadence ~10 ms by the spread above) refills behind it before the VP reaches its head. Claim S (P 0.6): each ON run's output lag-2400 share is <= 2%. The risks: Android's millisecond-granularity cond_timedwait oversleeping so the fifo falls below the low watermark and the VP refills in free-running bursts again (shows as starvation and as replays locked to P2048 in ON), or a writer cadence near 16.7 ms (an 800-sample step plus a 256-sample VP step passes a 992 lead by 64). Claim S-PSA (P 0.6): the same <= 2% in the PSA window. Claim T-ON (P 0.7): both ON runs' content slope over 0-25 s is 1.00 +/- 0.02, because in the slow-content runs the replays are what delayed the stream; OFF runs may be either mode (2 of 5 NFS captures so far were slow) and are reported, not judged. Claim L (P 0.85): mean ON level is within 0.5 dB of mean OFF. Claim F (P 0.9): ON gfps median >= OFF - 1.0. Claim Z (P 0.75): ON's starvation past the first 30 s window stays 0% (the original reason for the Android early return was speech sounding dragged out; that would show as starvation and a slope < 1). Lane.local's phase claim: if an ON run keeps >= 100 replay starts past 12 s, their lock at P2048 is < 0.2 (it is 0.78 in 837057).

legs.V (switch reached the app, else VOID): logcat carries 'apu_pace: on' in each ON run and 'apu_pace: off' in each OFF run, and request.json env matches the arm. A run without the line is void and is re-queued once, not judged.
legs.S (replays gone): fixjudge.py 'S': each ON lag-2400 share <= 2.0%. OFF expected 15-31%.
legs.S-PSA: fixjudge.py per-run PSA share: each ON <= 2.0%.
legs.T (content slope): fixjudge.py 'slope 0-25 s': each ON within 1.00 +/- 0.02; every run reported, and per the brief a slow intro does not count against S.
legs.L (level): fixjudge.py 'L': |mean ON - mean OFF| < 0.5 dB (audio_measure.py ac-rms, mean of L and R).
legs.F (frame rate): fixjudge.py 'F': mean of ON gfps medians >= mean of OFF gfps medians - 1.0 (hakuX-perf lines past 20 s).
legs.Z (starvation): fixjudge.py 'starvation per 30 s window', worst past the first window: 0% in each ON run.
legs.phase (reported): lock P2048 and P256 of replay starts past 12 s, per run.

expect_note: EMPTY of captures ON PURPOSE: a soak writes none. Legs are read off the pulled PCM and the logcat.
